_doc: House voice standard v2.0 (sv-12-voice): Hải Đăng preset with offline per-sentence fast rhythm (5.25 syllable-units/s, inside pauses >0.32s trimmed to 0.16s, pitch_ratio 1.02 via WSOLA), bilingual <en>...</en> support, ellipsis '...'/'…' and VieNeu V3 Turbo emotion tags allowed, plus per-sentence/per-segment fine-tuning in script.json. Shared by every episode; do not edit per episode.

engine._why: VieNeu V3 Turbo preset Hải Đăng with use_ref_codes=True and temperature=0.7/top_k=25/top_p=0.95 (approved ZIP sampling), synthesized sentence-by-sentence so each sentence's internal pauses (>0.32s -> 0.16s) and tempo/pitch (5.25 units/s, pitch 1.02) are controlled individually without uniform 1.25x distortion, while keeping automatic ASR/acoustic verification and up to 3 deterministic seed retries per sentence.

rhythm._doc: Offline per-sentence rhythm matching the approved 5.25 units/s lively Hải Đăng profile without external Edge-TTS or RubberBand dependencies. Authors may override wps, pause_after, tts_text, or seed per segment or per sentence in script.json.

text._doc: Rules for spoken text (tts_text if present, else text). script_lint SC-15..SC-17 and voice.py enforce them.
text._why: Numbers must be written in words for predictable reading; '...' and '…' are allowed for expressive phrasing because inside_pause_threshold_s trims any >0.32s hole to 0.16s; VieNeu V3 Turbo's 3 native inline emotion tokens ([cười], [thở dài], [hắng giọng] and English aliases) are allowed and stripped from display captions; English proper nouns/terms use <en>...</en> or top-level script.json 'english': [...] for native English G2P.

line_checks._doc: Every segment is measured against profile (below). [min, max]. If a sentence/segment fails, offending sentences regenerate with the next deterministic seed up to engine.max_attempts. Segments with explicit wps overrides check rate against their requested wps.

profile._doc: Calibrated Hải Đăng profile under v2.0 per-sentence rhythm (target_ups 5.25, pitch_ratio 1.02, inside holes >0.32s trimmed to 0.16s). rate_wps is syllable-units / segment duration (excluding emotion-cue allowance).
profile.calibrated: 2026-11-17, VieNeu V3 Turbo Hải Đăng preset (t0.7/k25/p0.95, use_ref_codes=True) + offline per-sentence rhythm (target_ups=5.25, pitch_ratio=1.02).
